Name: Aardvark
Overview:
Aardvark is a ball and paddle game that gives the player control of a paddle and tasks the player with destroying a formation of blocks with a metallic ball whilst making sure it does not fall below the paddle. As blocks get taken out, some will drop power-ups such as machine guns for the player's paddle that will allow him to clear out blocks faster. These are stackable, so you can have several queued at once. The game comes with 36 levels and the high scores are stored on leaderboards.

There is also a level editor included to allow players to come up with their own customized levels. A two player co-op mode is available for a team game to help clear blocks faster. Two players can also play against each other to clear their game field the fastest.
